name: Omni Studio
setup: export OMNI_SETUP_REV=20260925_audit_repairs; for omni_source in "${OMNI_STUDIO_SOURCE_DIR:-}" "$PWD" /opt/omni_studio/source /mnt/*/linux/template/app/apps/Omni_Studio; do [ -n "$omni_source" ] || continue; if [ -f "$omni_source/server/setup.sh" ] && [ -f "$omni_source/app.json" ]; then bash "$omni_source/server/setup.sh"; exit $?; fi; done; echo "Omni Studio source not found; set OMNI_STUDIO_SOURCE_DIR to the clone root inside Linux." >&2; exit 1
